from __future__ import annotations

import operator
import re
from collections.abc import Iterator
from dataclasses import dataclass

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"\s*(?:(\d+\.?\d*)|(\*\*|[-+*/()]))")

BINARY_OPS = {
    "+": (1, operator.add),
    "-": (1, operator.sub),
    "*": (2, operator.mul),
    "/": (2, operator.truediv),
    "**": (3, operator.pow),
}
RIGHT_ASSOCIATIVE = {"**"}


class ParseError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, message: str, position: int) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"{message} at position {position}")
        self.position = position


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Token:
    kind: str
    value: str
    position: int


def tokenize(source: str) -> Iterator[Token]:
    position = 0
    while position < len(source):
        match = TOKEN_RE.match(source, position)
        if match is None:
            raise ParseError("unexpected character", position)
        number, symbol = match.groups()
        if number is not None:

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, source: str) -> None:
        self._tokens = list(tokenize(source))
        self._index = 0

    def _advance(self) -> Token:
        token = self._tokens[self._index]
        self._index += 1
        return token

    def parse(self) -> float:
        value = self._expression(0)
        token = self._tokens[self._index]
        if token.kind != "end":
            raise ParseError(f"unexpected {token.value!r}", token.position)
        return value

    def _expression(self, min_precedence: int) -> float:
        left = self._unary()
        while True:
            token = self._tokens[self._index]
            if token.kind != "op" or token.value not in BINARY_OPS:
                return left
            precedence, func = BINARY_OPS[token.value]
            if precedence < min_precedence:
                return left
            self._advance()
            next_min = precedence if token.value in RIGHT_ASSOCIATIVE else precedence + 1
            left = func(left, self._expression(next_min))

    def _unary(self) -> float:
        token = self._advance()
        if token.kind == "number":
            return float(token.value)
        if token.value == "-":
            return -self._unary()
        if token.value == "(":
            value = self._expression(0)
            closing = self._advance()
            if closing.value != ")":
                raise ParseError("expected ')'", closing.position)
            return value
        raise ParseError(f"unexpected {token.value!r}", token.position)
